title: cataria paniculata
intro: Cataria paniculata, commonly known as German chamomile, is a flowering plant in the daisy family. It is widely used for its health benefits, which include promoting relaxation, reducing inflammation, and soothing digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of German chamomile include its sedative, anti-anxiety, and antispasmodic effects, making it a popular natural remedy for insomnia, anxiety disorders, and menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of German chamomile include apigenin, luteolin, and chamazulene, which contribute to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and calming properties.
